scale.source: KBBI VI Daring, "triliun": "12 nol (000.000.000.000) [...] (di Amerika Serikat dan Prancis, digunakan juga di Indonesia)". "miliar" is 10^9 and "triliun" 10^12 in Indonesia, so the scale changes no value.

group_mark.source: EYD V, "Tanda Titik", rule 8: "Tanda titik digunakan untuk memisahkan bilangan ribuan atau kelipatannya" ("13.000 pulau").

decimal_mark.source: EYD V, "Tanda Koma", rule 12: "Tanda koma digunakan sebelum angka desimal" ("12,5 m").

space_groups.source: CLDR 48 id number symbols group digits with a dot, so a space separates two numbers.

plural_scale_needs_count.source: "ribu", "juta" and the larger words take a count ("seribu", "dua juta").

scale_noun_agrees.source: An Indonesian scale word keeps one form after every count. CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "1000000: <%spellout-cardinal< juta;": "satu juta", "dua juta".

joiner_tens_units.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "21: <%spellout-cardinal< puluh >%spellout-cardinal>;": no joiner.

joiner_after_hundred.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "201: <%spellout-cardinal< ratus >%spellout-cardinal>;": no joiner.

joiner_between_groups.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "2001: <%spellout-cardinal< ribu >%spellout-cardinal>;": no joiner.

joiner_before_round_hundred.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "2001: <%spellout-cardinal< ribu >%spellout-cardinal>;": no joiner after the thousands, so no group follows one.

small_multiplier_starts_group.source: unicode-rbnf 2.4.1 (CLDR RBNF id data), %spellout-cardinal, rendering of 1100 and 2100: "seribu seratus", "dua ribu seratus": the hundred after the thousands is the next group, so a hundred multiplier counts no group of thousands.

comma_between_classes.source: The CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id rules quoted for joiner_between_groups write no comma between two classes. No source opened shows a comma between two classes of one number, so a comma ends a number.

joiner_before_last_group.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "2001: <%spellout-cardinal< ribu >%spellout-cardinal>;": no joiner before the last group.

joiner_before_half.source: EYD V, G.8.b: "tiga dua-pertiga (3⅔)"; KBBI, "setengah": "seperdua": a half or a fraction follows the whole number with no joiner ("dua setengah", "tiga dua-pertiga").

ordinal_style.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-ordinal: "2: ke=%spellout-cardinal=;": "ke-" makes the whole cardinal after it an ordinal.

compound_words.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "100: seratus;", "1000: seribu;": "se-" and "ke-" are part of the word ("seratus", "kedua"), so a word splits into number words.

decimal_marker.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "x.x: << titik >>;", "x,x: << koma >>;" No national source names the spoken word; CLDR is the source.

minus.source: CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "-x: negatif >%spellout-cardinal>;"; "minus" is read the same.

minus_idioms.source: No Indonesian idiom puts "minus" before a positive number.

article_one.source: Indonesian has no article that is also the number one; "se-" is part of a word.

of.source: Indonesian puts the noun after the number with no preposition.

fraction_of.source: Indonesian puts the noun after the number with no preposition.

denominator_particle.source: Indonesian has no particle like pt "avos".

class_noun.source: No Indonesian class noun is read.

half_unit.source: No Indonesian unit takes a half before it.

lone_decimal_mark.source: CLDR 48 id number symbols: decimal ",", so ",5" is 0.5.

range_cue.source: KBBI VI Daring, "antara": "di tengah-tengah dua waktu (peristiwa, bilangan, bobot): kerajaan itu ditaklukkan -- tahun 1774 dan 1778".

KBBI VI Daring, "se-": "bentuk terikat satu"; "sebelas": "angka 11", "seratus": "angka 100", "seribu": "angka 1.000".
KBBI VI Daring, "puluh": "satuan bilangan kelipatan sepuluh yang dilambangkan dengan sebuah nol (0) di belakang angka 1—9".
KBBI VI Daring, "belas": "satuan bilangan dari 11—19"; CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "12: >%spellout-cardinal> belas;"
KBBI VI Daring, "ratus": "satuan bilangan kelipatan seratus yang dilambangkan dengan dua nol (00) di belakang angka 1—9".
KBBI VI Daring, "ribu": "satuan bilangan kelipatan seribu yang dilambangkan dengan tiga nol (000) di belakang angka 1—999".
KBBI VI Daring, "juta": "satuan bilangan kelipatan sejuta yang dilambangkan dengan enam nol (000.000) di belakang angka 1—999".
KBBI VI Daring, "miliar": "bentuk tidak baku: milyar [...] sembilan nol (000.000.000)".
KBBI VI Daring, "miliar": "bentuk tidak baku: milyar [...] sembilan nol (000.000.000)".
KBBI VI Daring, "triliun": "12 nol (000.000.000.000) [...] (di Amerika Serikat dan Prancis, digunakan juga di Indonesia)".
KBBI VI Daring, "lusin": "satuan jumlah sama dengan 12 buah: dibelinya piring satu --, mangkuk dua --".
KBBI VI Daring, "setengah": "seperdua; separuh"; CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "x,x: << koma >>;" has no half, so "dua setengah" (2.5) follows the KBBI sense.
KBBI VI Daring, "setengah": "seperdua; separuh"; CLDR 48 RBNF (ICU 78) id %spellout-cardinal: "x,x: << koma >>;" has no half, so "dua setengah" (2.5) follows the KBBI sense.

EYD V, "Angka dan Bilangan", G.8.b: "Bilangan pecahan ditulis dengan per- yang dilekatkan pada bilangan penyebut yang mengikutinya. [...] seperenam belas (⅟16) tiga perempat (¾) dua persepuluh (²∕₁₀) tiga dua-pertiga (3⅔)": "per-" makes the whole number after it the denominator.
KBBI VI Daring, "pertama": "num kesatu".

KBBI VI Daring, "ke-": "prefiks pembentuk numeralia tingkat atau urutan: ketiga; kelima; kesebelas" and "prefiks pembentuk numeralia kumpulan: kedua (buku); ketiga (orang)"; "kedua": "num nomor dua: anaknya yang ~ lahir kemarin" and "num kelompok yang terdiri atas dua (orang dan barang): ~ mobilnya disita kejaksaan". The group sense starts its phrase before a noun, the ordinal follows a word ("anaknya yang ~", "juara ~"), so a ke- word that starts a phrase and has a word after it is a weak ordinal. EYD V, "Angka dan Bilangan", G.9: "abad ke-7 [...] Perang Dunia Ke-2".

writer.source: CLDR 44 RBNF id (common/rbnf/id.xml as shipped in unicode-rbnf 2.5.1); a rule changed from it carries its own source, and the source of a rule set names the CLDR rules that are left out

spellout-cardinal.source: CLDR 44 RBNF id (common/rbnf/id.xml as shipped in unicode-rbnf 2.5.1), %spellout-cardinal. Left out: the rules x.x and x,x, and the rules for 10^15 (kuadriliun) and 10^18 (=#,##0.#=). ovos-number-parser 0.31.4a8 numbers_id.py, _pronounce_int, has a scale table that ends at "triliun", so it writes 10^15 as "seribu triliun" and 10^18 as "satu juta triliun", and the golden file of its writer holds that output.

rules.source: ovos-number-parser 0.31.4a8 numbers_id.py _pronounce_number (id): "minus " before the reading; the CLDR rule says "negatif".

spellout-ordinal.source: CLDR 44 RBNF id (common/rbnf/id.xml as shipped in unicode-rbnf 2.5.1), %spellout-ordinal. Left out: the rules -x and x.x. The ordinal form takes whole numbers from 1 (minimum), as ovos-number-parser 0.31.4a8 numbers_id.py, _pronounce_ordinal, does: it raises ValueError for any other number.

decimal.source: CLDR 44 RBNF id (common/rbnf/id.xml as shipped in unicode-rbnf 2.5.1), %spellout-cardinal x,x: "←← koma →→". The digits after the word read one by one, as ovos-number-parser 0.31.4a8 numbers_id.py reads them.

fraction.source: ovos-number-parser 0.31.4a8 numbers_id.py, _nice_number: "setengah" is 1/2, "per" and the cardinal make the other denominators, "se" replaces the numerator one ("seperempat"). Denominators above 20 read as the cardinal numerator and the ordinal denominator.
